OUR BRANCHES
At American Vet Center, we make expert veterinary care easy and accessible with six clinics across Egypt: Zamalek, Sheikh Zayed, Sheraton (Heliopolis), Ma’adi, New Cairo (Rehab), and Alexandria. Each location is staffed by our experienced veterinarians and equipped with modern facilities to provide everything your pet needs — from routine check-ups and vaccinations to dental care, diagnostics, surgery, and emergency services. Wherever you are, compassionate, high-quality care for your pets is always nearby.
Find and Click your nearest clinic below and book your visit today — we’re here 7 days a week.
